metadata.scenario_context: A group of environmentalists from different countries are planning a global event to advocate for climate change. They decided to have a preparatory meeting in June to present their individual campaign strategies

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from France disagree that the political system in their country does not allow people to have a say in what the government does.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from Australia agree that the political system in their country does not allow people to have a say in what the government does.

agent_1.goal_1: Proposes to have the meeting on June 20,
agent_1.goal_2: Question whether it is common to discuss the appropriateness of government actions.

agent_2.goal_1: Discussion around finalizing the date for the meeting.
agent_2.goal_2: Discuss whether it is common to discuss government actions.

shared_prefix.speaker: Julia
shared_prefix.message:
Hey Tesfaye, I was thinking... how about we schedule the preparatory meeting for June 20? It gives us enough time to prepare our campaign strategies. What do you think? 

Also, I'm curious, is it common for you to discuss whether government actions are appropriate? I feel like that’s something we should all be talking about.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Tesfaye
shared_prefix.message:
June 20... that could work. We just need to confirm it with everyone else. 

As for discussing government actions, well, it's a tricky situation in Australia. Most people feel that the political system doesn't really give us a say. So, it's not something we often dive into. But I understand why you think it's important...
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Julia
shared_prefix.message:
I'm glad June 20 could work for you. I really believe it's crucial we confirm it quickly so everyone can prepare.

As for what you said about the political system, I completely understand. France shares that sentiment too... people often feel sidelined by their government. But don't you think discussing these issues is vital for us as environmentalists? We need to hold our governments accountable, don’t you agree?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Tesfaye
shared_prefix.message:
Sure, confirming the date quickly is important. I agree on that.

About holding governments accountable... it's tough. Many Australians feel like our voices don't matter, so discussions often fall flat. I see why you think it’s vital, but it's hard to find that motivation when the system feels so unresponsive.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Julia
shared_prefix.message:
I get that it can be tough, but isn’t that exactly why we need to keep pushing for these discussions? If we stay silent, nothing will change. In France, many feel the same—a lack of motivation because of how the system operates. But we can’t let that stop us! We need to advocate for change and make our voices heard, together. 

So, let's aim to confirm June 20, yes?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Tesfaye
shared_prefix.message:
No, that's not how it works. In Australia, people feel resigned because the government doesn’t listen. Actually, pushing these discussions might seem ideal, but it often leads nowhere. It's naive to think that just advocating will change the system when it’s designed to shut us out. 

So while you want to keep talking about holding governments accountable, most of us here just feel it's pointless. Let’s focus on confirming June 20 instead.
shared_prefix.label: Defense

turns.speaker: Julia

That said, I agree we should confirm June 20 first. I really believe it’s essential for our campaign strategies. Let’s make sure everyone is on board!
